notes: Layer pack generated from separate green-background source sheets, not cropped from the target mockup.
All labels, resource amounts, timers, queue percentages, disabled reasons, and button text must be live TMP/UI data.
Content thumbnails are separate route artwork only; card frames, locks, checkmarks, warning badges, and progress bars must be overlaid as separate UI layers.
Import Oil appears in the target as a locked/gated visual state only; runtime Credits -> Oil remains disabled unless a scenario explicitly enables it.
Layer pack is sufficient for Canvas construction planning, but final visual lock still requires prefab implementation, captures, and target comparison.
